SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: At GlobalQualityWeight 0.1, ResolveSimulationInterval maps the CPU Burst visor solver to 5 Hz. At GlobalQualityWeight 1.0 it maps to 60 Hz. The transition uses a smooth polynomial and math.lerp, with event paths forcing a single immediate schedule for breath, splash, wipe, pressure, scalability change, and glitch. Below approximately 0.3, CPU updates are sparse, compute-mask blend resolves to zero, the shader resolves LowTierWeight01/dynamicVisorWeight/refractionWeight, skips ComputeDropletMask value-noise work, avoids Snell refraction sampling, and renders a static edge-weighted film plus chroma fallback. Hardware pressure is continuous: VRAM headroom is curved against the configured threshold rather than converted into a binary low-tier switch. High-speed visual suppression is also continuous: local velocity squared fades thermal distortion out across a 12-15 m/s Smooth01 ramp instead of a single threshold. Middle quality enables a small downscaled compute mask for condensation/crack/dirt. High and ultra increase compute mask render scale and restore 60 Hz scalar updates, head-motion UV skew, richer refraction, reflection tint, salt crystals, and suspended silt presentation only when GlobalQualityWeight and thermal headroom allow it.

POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.COMPLETION_POLICY: Tick never completes the job. It returns while scheduled work is active. LateFrameTick is the nonblocking visual-sync commit point and OnDisable is the only forced completion site because shutdown must reclaim graphics/native ownership.
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.MUTATION_BARRIER: External mock, pressure, silt, surface, wipe, scalability-version, and editor writes stage primitive pending fields while _hasScheduledWork is true. Pending values are copied into Vault buffers only before the next schedule, after the previous job has committed.
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.GPU_BUFFER_POLICY: Diegetic visor lens globals, the existing visor fluid RenderGraph globals, and the compute-mask scalar payload use ping-pong GraphicsBuffer constant buffers. Runtime and render feature writes alternate buffers, then bind the just-written buffer. Render feature buffers are prewarmed in Create and RecordRenderGraph refuses allocation if they are unavailable. The literal compute path is a RenderGraph compute pass that writes a transient random-write `_HectonDiegeticVisorLensMaskTex`; it imports the active 80-byte `HectonDiegeticVisorLensComputeGlobals` buffer, declares `UseBuffer(..., AccessFlags.Read)`, binds it with `SetComputeConstantBufferParam`, and creates the mask descriptor with explicit width/height, xrReady=false, slices=1, Tex2D, VRTextureUsage.None, clamp wrap, no dynamic scale, and no mips before declared read access in the raster visor pass.
